## What you need, and what for

<!-- The use case matters more than the proposed API: these libraries add
     capability on evidence from real consumers rather than speculation. -->

## Which layer it belongs to

<!-- The family is strictly layered: builder (elements, attributes,
     components, render) → ui (components on the builder, with a client
     half where behaviour needs one). A capability usually belongs to the
     lowest layer that can provide it. If you are asking a component for
     something the builder should expose, say so — that is a builder issue
     with a consumer's evidence attached. -->
